editor.hint.forests: Frequency: number of groves · Size: extent · Density: trees per grove
editor.hint.rocks: Frequency: number of outcrops · Size: extent · Density: rocks per outcrop
editor.hint.ores: Frequency: number of deposits · Size: extent of each pile · Density: ore per cell
editor.hint.water: Frequency: number of ponds · Size: surface · Density: chance of a pond per area
editor.hint.enemies: Frequency: number of nests · Size: starting colony size · Density: chance of a nest per area
editor.enemies.aggressive.help: They attack the player and their installations. Off by default.
editor.enemies.expand.help: They grow (faster with pollution) and found new nests. On by default.
editor.realism.help: Heat, pressure, electricity… Will apply once these systems are in the game.
editor.preview.title: World preview (top view)
editor.preview.note: 320 m square around the starting point. The white circle marks the guaranteed start area (150 m).
inv.title: Bag
inv.hint: Click: select · right-click: half onto the cursor · Ctrl + click: choose the amount · Shift + click: send to the other inventory (machine, chest). Dragging a stack out of the window drops it on the ground.
manage.renameGame.title: Rename the game

manage.name: New name
manage.nameTaken: Another save already has this name.

import.error.tooBig: The file is too big to be a game.

build.title: Building
build.help: {@rotate}: lock / rotate 90° · {@levelUp} / {@levelDown}: floor · {@layerUp} / {@layerDown}: wall height (top view) · Hold {@interact}: area or wall · Hold {@remove}: demolish · same slot: put away
build.missing: Item not in the bag: craft it in the inventory
build.inRoom: You are inside a closed room
inv.raw: Raw resource: it is gathered, not crafted.
inv.selectHint: Click a stack to select it (a placeable item stays in hand when you close the bag).
build.unsupported: A wall cannot float: place it on the ground or against an existing wall
build.wallHeight: Wall height in top view: {n} block(s) ({cm} cm)
build.unsupportedCeiling: A ceiling attaches to the top of walls: place it against a wall or extend a slab (3 cells max from a wall)
hotbar.tool: Tool (one tool harvests everything) / pistol: used automatically when an action needs it
hotbar.hint: Shortcut bar: drag an item from the bag onto a slot, or select it in the bag then click a slot. Right-click a slot to empty it.
build.unsupportedStairs: Stairs go on the ground, on a floor slab, or continue another flight upward
factory.hint.noMould: No mould: cast it at the furnace (cast iron) and put it in the slot.
factory.refuse.noRecipe: choose a recipe in the window first
factory.needOre: A drill must be placed on ore
factory.helpMachine: {@rotate}: orient the output · {@levelUp} / {@levelDown}: upstairs on a slab / ground · {@interact}: place · same slot: put away
factory.helpPipe: {@rotate}: direction · {@levelDown}: tunnel entrance template (the exit shows at max range, 4 tiles) · while dragging, {@levelDown}: chained tunnels · hold {@interact} and drag to lay several pipes · same cell: pick up
factory.helpConveyor: {@rotate}: direction · {@levelUp} / {@levelDown}: go up / down (ramp) while tracing · {@levelDown} without tracing: tunnel template (exit at max range by belt tier: 4 / 8 / 16 tiles), while tracing: chained tunnels · hold {@interact} and trace to place several belts in a row · same slot: put away
machine.dragHint: Click: pick the stack up on the cursor (then click a slot to drop it) · right-click: half · Ctrl + click: an amount · Shift + click: straight to the other inventory.
machine.chestHint: Same gestures as the bag: click = the stack on the cursor, right-click = half, Ctrl + click = an amount, Shift + click = straight to the bag.
factory.power.none: not connected: place a pole within {m} m
factory.power.pole: Grid: {n} machine(s) · production {cap} kW · demand {demand} kW
factory.router.splitter: Splits one belt into 3 outputs (front, left, right), in turn.
factory.router.merger: Merges up to 3 belts (back, left, right) into the front output.
inv.pickInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to {max}.
factory.router.sorter: Like the splitter (1 input behind, 3 outputs: front, left, right) but each output has its own filter (whitelist or blacklist of items, set in its window): it routes each item to the output that accepts it. Electric (15 kW).
factory.router.arm_filter: Like the electric arm but 3 times faster (0.3 s) and with a whitelist or blacklist filter (set in its window): it only takes allowed items. Electric (30 kW).
factory.router.arm: Picks items from 3 sides (back, left, right: belt, chest, machine) and drops them in front. It burns fuel and refuels itself from nearby containers when running low.
map.title: Map
map.help: Drag to pan, mouse wheel or + / − to zoom, {@map} or Esc to close. Distant areas appear progressively.
factory.router.arm_electric: Like the fuel arm but powered through a pole (20 kW): twice as fast. Picks from 3 sides (back, left, right) and drops in front.
factory.router.assembler: Crafts the chosen item from ingredients brought by belts or arms (any side except the front output). Electric: 60 kW.
machine.ingHint: Same gestures as the bag on the ingredient slot (click, right-click, Ctrl + click).
factory.arm.diag.ok: Ready: an item can be picked.
factory.arm.diag.noDest: Nothing in front: place a machine, belt or chest in front.
factory.arm.diag.noSource: Nothing to pick behind, left or right.
factory.arm.diag.refused: Items are nearby but the destination refuses them (e.g. fuel through the output face of a furnace or drill; ore: furnace already full of another ore; an item that cannot be smelted).
factory.block.nothing: End of belt: {item} has nowhere to go (nothing in front).
factory.block.waiting: Just a moment, the cell in front is clearing.
factory.refuse.merger: a merger pulls from belts that touch it itself — connect it with a belt pointing at it
factory.refuse.facing: the next belt faces this one
factory.refuse.otherOre: the furnace already holds another ore (one type at a time)
factory.refuse.notUsable: it has no use for this item
factory.refuse.fuelFull: the fuel slot is full or holds another type
factory.refuse.ingredientFull: enough of this ingredient is waiting
factory.refuse.notIngredient: not an ingredient of the recipe
discovery.title: Discovery (tier 0)
machine.filter.title: Filter
machine.filter.deny: Everything passes except the checked items (blacklist)
equip.title: Equipment
equip.head: Head
equip.hint: Drag or click equipment from the bag onto its slot. Click a filled slot to take it off.
equip.bagFull: Cannot remove it: the bag would be too full without it.
tech.title: Technologies
tech.missing: Not enough resources in the bag
tech.help: The cost is taken from the bag. T or Esc to close.
factory.router.lab: Studies the chosen technology ({@techTree}) using science packs brought by belts or arms. 30 kW.
tech.labHint: Place a laboratory fed with science packs (belt, arm or by hand): it uses the packs for this technology.
factory.power.blackout: BLACKOUT: the grid is down. Cut the demand, then turn a crank.
factory.power.overload: Overloaded for {s} s: the grid is about to go down
machine.crank.help: A crank placed near a pole restarts the grid after a blackout, as long as production covers the demand.
machine.crank.running: The grid is running: nothing to restart.
machine.crank.tooMuch: Demand too high: cut machines or add generators.
machine.crank.unlinked: Crank not connected: place a pole nearby.
factory.status.broken: Out of order (burst, damaged or broken down): replace it with a new one of the same tier, or repair it
factory.fluid.noPressure: No pressure: the fluid stops flowing (place a booster)
factory.fluid.broken: Burst pipe: it leaks. Place a new pipe on top to repair it, or a higher-tier pipe.
factory.router.booster: Booster: fluid enters behind and leaves in front with +2 bar. Electric (30 kW). Use it when pressure drops to 0 along a long line.
factory.router.barreler: Fills an empty barrel with 100 L of water or empties a water barrel (pick the recipe). Water flows through the sides, barrels enter behind and leave in front.
factory.router.washer: Washes ore: 2 raw ore + 20 L of water → 3 purified ore. Water comes in by the sides, items enter behind.
factory.pipeBurst: A pipe just burst: pressure too high for its tier!
factory.router.cooling_tower: Cools the hot water rejected by machines: it enters behind and leaves cold in front (20 L/s), no energy needed.
machine.cooling.help: Cold pressurised water on one side: +50% speed (4 L/s). Water leaves hot on the other side: send it to a boiler (half the fuel) or a cooling tower.
factory.router.furnace_electric: High-temperature electric furnace (200 kW): smelts sand with coal into raw silicon. Pollutes the air. Cold pressurised water on one side: +50% speed.
factory.router.pumpjack: Pumps oil from a deposit (place it on top): 1 L/s, 4 bar, 60 kW. The deposit is finite. Oil output in front.
factory.router.refinery: High-pressure oil (8 bar minimum: boosters, brass or steel pipes) → liquid polymer, 10 L/s, 150 kW. Oil on one side, polymer on the other. Pollutes the air.
factory.router.plastic_press: Injection press: 20 L of polymer (left side) → 4 plastic insulators in 3 s, 80 kW.
machine.labHint: 4 science pack slots (stacks of 20), of different types: the lab uses the least valuable pack first.
factory.status.wrongPack: These packs are not used by the current study
threat.acid: A spitter damaged a belt or a pipe: place a new one of the same tier on top to repair it.
editor.tutorial.help: A panel in the top right guides your first steps: movement, camera, gathering, first furnace. You can skip it at any time.
tutorial.title: Tutorial
tutorial.done: Well done, the tutorial is over! Place more furnaces, build belts, open the technology tree.
tutorial.step.look: Turn the camera with the mouse: left, right, up and down (hold right click in top view)
tutorial.step.view: Go through the 3 views with {keys}: first person, third person, top view
tutorial.step.wood: Pick up 6 wood: get close to a tree or a branch and hold {keys}
tutorial.step.stone: Hit a rock to harvest 4 stone: hold {keys}
tutorial.step.tool: Craft your first {tool} by hand (bag: {keys}) with {wood} and {stone}: one tool harvests everything
tutorial.step.equip: Equip your tool: select it in the bag ({keys}) then click the last slot of the hotbar (the tool slot, on the right), or drag it onto it
tutorial.step.furnace: Craft a {furnace} (bag: {keys}), pick it in the bar and place it on the ground
tutorial.step.coal: Put {coal} in the {furnace}: aim at it and press {keys}, then place the {coal} as fuel
tutorial.step.iron: Also add {ore} to the {furnace}, pick the recipe “{recipe}” and wait: you get one {ingot} per cycle
editor.distance.help: The higher it is, the more massive but spaced out distant deposits are (×1 = normal).
editor.mode.help: Creative: free research and crafting, bag with no weight or volume limit, enemies ignore you.
factory.router.centrifuge: Splits uraninite into enriched uranium (fuel) and depleted uranium (waste, used by T4 packs). 120 kW.
factory.router.fission_reactor: Burns uranium rods (1 per 2 minutes) with high-pressure water (12 bar minimum, 20 L/s): 10 MW. Releases contaminated water (pipe it away) and nuclear waste (output in front). Without water, or if an output is full: it overheats and breaks down.
machine.repair: Repair (30 steel plates, 10 insulated cables, 5 chips)
machine.reactor.help: Broken reactor? Repairs need T3 components: steel plates, insulated cables and silicon chips.
recipe.vitrify: Contaminated glass cylinder (100 L of contaminated water + 4 stone + 2 insulators)
factory.router.evaporation_tower: Evaporates contaminated water (20 L/s, no energy) but releases toxic purple vapour: it feeds nearby nests, which spawn bigger, tougher mutants. Place it FAR from nests.
factory.router.vitrifier: Locks 100 L of contaminated water with 4 stone and 2 plastic insulators into a contaminated glass cylinder (solid, storable, 100 kW). Water comes in by the left side, items from behind.
threat.mutants: Nests mutated under the toxic vapour!
factory.router.accumulator: Stores 1 GJ: charges from the grid surplus (25 MW) and gives it back when demand exceeds production (up to 50 MW). Ten are needed for the 500 MW fusion priming.
factory.router.fusion_reactor: Priming: 500 MW for 10 s from accumulators. Once the plasma is lit (150 million degrees): magnets 50 MW, output 500 MW (Q = 10). Burns 1 solid nuclear waste + 1 contaminated glass cylinder every 30 s; without fuel or if the grid trips, the plasma collapses.
factory.router.relay: Microwave relay: connects the antenna to the grid and triggers the beacon while the fusion plasma burns.
factory.router.antenna: Quantum alignment antenna: place it near the relay, on the same grid.
machine.fusion.help: Fuel: solid nuclear waste and contaminated glass cylinders (one of each every 30 s).
machine.repair.fusion: Repair (100 steel plates, 40 zamak, 40 insulated cables)
machine.beacon.help: The fusion reactor must be lit and the antenna connected to the same grid.
machine.beacon.noPlasma: The fusion reactor must be burning.
machine.beacon.noAntenna: Place the antenna on the same grid.
machine.beacon.done: The beacon has already been activated.
finale.line2: [MESSAGE RECEIVED]: "This is Orion Station. Surface signal recorded. Congratulations, Engineer."
finale.line4: The relay becomes a space trading post: the game goes on.
trade.title: Space trading post — {n} galactic credits
trade.help: Sell what is in your bag (half price), buy any item or resource (one and a half times the price). Belts and arms feeding the relay sell their content automatically.
inv.craftHint: Left click: craft 1 · Right click: craft 5 (crafting takes time: a tool makes it faster)
editor.mp.title: Multiplayer
editor.mp.help: Up to {n} players. The host runs the game; the others join with an invitation code. (Settings only for now: networking is not connected yet.)
editor.mp.enable.help: Enables the settings below for this game.
editor.mp.visibility.help: Private: only players invited by the host can join. Public: an address lets anyone come, with or without a password.
join.name: Your name
join.badCode: This code is not valid (6 characters).
join.unreachable: Game not found: check the code, and that the host opened the game.
join.refused.version: The host does not have the same game version.
join.refused.closed: This game does not accept guests.
join.lost: The connection to the host was lost.
join.diverged: The host did not accept one of your actions.
pause.save.guest: Host's game: the host saves it.
pause.multi.closed: The game is not open to guests yet.
pause.multi.error: Could not open the game (matchmaking service unreachable).
pause.multi.open.help: Give this code (or the link) to your friends: they pick “Join a game”.
pause.multi.approve: {name} wants to join your game. Accept?
factory.router.pipe: Carries water or steam (one fluid at a time). Connects to neighbouring fluid machines.
factory.router.pump: Pumps water from a neighbouring pond (place it at the water's edge): 100 units/s, 20 kW. Output in front.
factory.router.boiler: Water in one side and out the other (boilers in series); fuel at the back (belts, arms), steam out the front. 60 steam/s at full heat.
factory.router.turbine: Steam in (back), the rest leaves in front (next turbine). Up to 200 kW if pressure stays high enough.
factory.needWater: A pump goes at the water's edge: the output-side row on land, the rest in the pond.
threat.machineLost: An installation was destroyed by enemies!
threat.knockedOut: You were knocked out: your belongings stay on your body (✝ on the map).
corpse.hint: Your body: F to recover your belongings.
corpse.empty: Nothing left to recover: the body fades away.
corpse.bagFull: Your bag is full: the rest waits on your body.
spawn.bagPlaced: Sleeping bag placed: you will respawn here (once).
spawn.bedPlaced: Bed placed: you will respawn here.
vehicle.mount: Buggy: F to get in / out, Shift + F to pack it
vehicle.noFuel: The buggy is out of fuel (coal or wood in your bag).
vehicle.placed: Buggy placed: F to get in.
factory.power.consumer: {kw} kW · the grid produces {cap} kW for {demand} kW demanded ({pct} % supplied)
factory.turbine.help: It produces from 20 % pressure and at full power (200 kW) at 60 %; steam comes from the boiler.
factory.status.noStudy: No study chosen: open technologies (T) and start a science-pack research
factory.hint.noPower: The grid does not produce enough: a generator needs fuel, or a turbine enough steam (pressure ≥ 20 %). Also check the poles (wire reach).
factory.hint.noWater: No water: check the pump (at the water's edge) and the pipes up to one side of the boiler. Without power the pump runs at 20 % to prime the circuit.
editor.time.title: Day, night and seasons
editor.time.help: Three independent settings. Default: a day lasts 10 min, a night 8 min, a season 10 days and 10 nights.
editor.time.pie: Share of each season in the year
editor.time.pieHelp: Drag the white dots on the pie to grow or shrink a season (5 % minimum). The year lasts 4 times the average season length.
weapon.noMagazine: No magazine left in the bag
